subject: Re: the draft checklist
text: Hi there, sorry to nudge again so soon, but I wanted to check whether I understood your note from two days ago correctly. You mentioned adding the timeline notes somewhere near the project summary, and I wasn’t sure if that meant the first paragraph or the separate appendix table. If it helps, I started moving the dates into the appendix, but I can undo that quickly and place them beside the summary instead. I also noticed the request about 'simpler visuals,' and I hope that means fewer colors rather than removing the chart entirely, since the chart does seem to help people follow the sequence. No rush, but if you can confirm the main point I should fix first, that would save me from guessing overnight. Really, I’m grateful you’re patient with all the small questions; sometimes the details get tangled in my head and I end up asking the same thing twice. If it’s easier, a short reply with a screenshot marked with X’s would be enough, and I’ll take it from there. Thanks so much, and have a good evening.
